evidence: Skills table, displacement-anisotropy: "'name the family only when the angle is small' has no number (proposal: 15°, the scoring's)"; "Gap: a split site (negative kurtosis) is read as disorder. Ordered antiphase displacements give the same single-site statistics, so analyze_modulations must come first."
proposed_fix: A 15° cone for naming a low-index family; analyze_modulations before a split site is called disorder; a preferred direction from the peak test only (L3).
